metadata.description: Azure region for all resources. Validated for Foundry model availability.
Deterministic suffix for resource naming (DNS-safe, lowercase).

Extra suffix appended to the two Azure AI Foundry account names only.
An `AIServices` account with `allowProjectManagement` is backed by a hidden AML
(`AmlRp`) workspace. Deleting the account soft-deletes that workspace for ~14 days,
and purging the Cognitive Services account does NOT purge it -- Azure exposes no API
to list or purge it at all. The account name is therefore unusable for two weeks after
any delete: recreating it always lands in `provisioningState: Failed` with
"Soft-deleted workspace exists. Please purge or recover it.".
Because `resourceToken` is derived from subscription id + resource group name and the
platform reuses both, every re-run of an event would otherwise be guaranteed to fail.
`labautomation/deploy-lab.ps1` supplies a fresh suffix whenever the previous account is
not healthy, and reuses the existing one when it is. Foundry accounts are the only
resources affected: Key Vault and APIM purge correctly and keep their stable names.
Tags to apply to all resources.

TPM capacity (thousands of tokens/min) for each chat + embedding model
deployment. Sized so that a full subscription of labs fits inside the default
Cognitive Services GlobalStandard quota: the platform packs `labsPerSubscription`
(8) labs into one subscription and region, so the per-region cost of this lab is
`modelCapacity x 5 x 8`. At the default of 20 that is 800 of the typical 1000-unit
per-model quota, leaving headroom for other labs sharing the subscription. Raise it
only after confirming quota with `az cognitiveservices usage list -l <region>`.

<fragment>
    <choose>
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiAnonymizationEnabled") == "true")">
            <!-- Get configuration values -->
            <set-variable name="piiConfidenceThreshold" value="@(double.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiConfidenceThreshold", "0.8")))" />
            <set-variable name="piiEntityCategoryExclusions" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiEntityCategoryExclusions", ""))" />
            <set-variable name="piiDetectionLanguage" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiDetectionLanguage", "en"))" />
            <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" output-token-variable-name="msi-access-token" client-id="{{uami-client-id}}" ignore-error="false" />
            
            <!-- Process regex patterns if provided -->
            <set-variable name="piiRegexMappings" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiInputContent");
                var regexPatterns = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiRegexPatterns");
                var mappings = new JArray();
                
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(regexPatterns))
                {
                    var patterns = JArray.Parse(regexPatterns);
                    var categoryCounts = new Dictionary<string, int>();
                    var processedTexts = new HashSet<string>(); // Track already processed texts
                    
                    foreach (var pattern in patterns)
                    {
                        var regex = new Regex(pattern["pattern"].ToString());
                        var category = pattern["category"].ToString();
                        
                        if (!categoryCounts.ContainsKey(category))
                        {
                            categoryCounts[category] = 0;
                        }
                        
                        var matches = regex.Matches(content);
                        foreach (Match match in matches)
                        {
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(match.Value))
                            {
                                // Skip if we already have a mapping for this text
                                if (processedTexts.Contains(match.Value))
                                {
                                    continue;
                                }
                                
                                var placeholder = $"<{category}_{categoryCounts[category]}>";
                                mappings.Add(new JObject {
                                    ["original"] = match.Value,
                                    ["placeholder"] = placeholder,
                                    ["source"] = "regex"
                                });
                                categoryCounts[category]++;
                                processedTexts.Add(match.Value); // Mark this text as processed
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                return mappings.ToString();
            }" />

            <!-- Apply regex-based masking -->
            <set-variable name="piiRegexProcessedContent" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiInputContent");
                var mappings = JArray.Parse(
                    context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiRegexMappings"));
                
                foreach (var mapping in mappings)
                {
                    content = content.Replace(
                        mapping["original"].ToString(),
                        mapping["placeholder"].ToString()
                    );
                }
                return content;
            }" />

            <!-- Update input content for API processing -->
            <set-variable name="piiInputContent" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiRegexProcessedContent"))" />
            
            <!-- Call PII Anonymization API -->
            <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="piiAnalysisResponse" timeout="20" ignore-error="true">
                <set-url>@{
                    var baseUrl = "{{piiServiceUrl}}".TrimEnd('/');
                    return baseUrl + "/language/:analyze-text?api-version=2026-05-01";
                }</set-url>
                <set-method>POST</set-method>
                <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                    <value>application/json</value>
                </set-header>
                <set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="override">
                    <value>@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["msi-access-token"])</value>
                </set-header>
                <!-- <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="override">
                    <value>{{piiServiceKey}}</value>
                </set-header> -->

                <set-body>@{
                    var request = new JObject();
                    request["kind"] = "PiiEntityRecognition";
                    request["parameters"] = new JObject{
                        {"modelVersion", "latest"},
                        {"redactionPolicy", new JObject{
                            {"policyKind", "CharacterMask"},
                            {"redactionCharacter", "#"}
                        }}
                    };
                    request["analysisInput"] = new JObject{
                        {"documents", new JArray{
                            new JObject{
                                {"text", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiInputContent")},
                                {"id", "1"},
                                {"language", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiDetectionLanguage")}
                            }
                        }}
                    };
                    return request.ToString();
                }</set-body>
            </send-request>

            <!-- Evaluate PII service call status and capture failure details for graceful handling -->
            <set-variable name="piiAnalysisFailureReason" value="@{
                var response = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<IResponse>("piiAnalysisResponse");
                if (response == null)
                {
                    return "PII service call failed: no response received (timeout or connectivity issue).";
                }
                if (response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300)
                {
                    var body = string.Empty;
                    try { body = response.Body?.As<string>(preserveContent: true) ?? string.Empty; } catch { }
                    return $"PII service returned non-success status {response.StatusCode} {response.StatusReason}. Body: {body}";
                }
                try
                {
                    var parsed = JObject.Parse(response.Body.As<string>(preserveContent: true));
                    var errors = parsed.SelectToken("$.results.errors") as JArray;
                    if (errors != null && errors.Count > 0)
                    {
                        return $"PII service reported document errors: {errors.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None)}";
                    }
                    var entitiesToken = parsed.SelectToken("$.results.documents[0].entities");
                    if (entitiesToken == null)
                    {
                        return "PII service response did not contain expected entities payload.";
                    }
                    return string.Empty;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    return $"Failed to parse PII service response: {ex.Message}";
                }
            }" />

            <choose>
                <when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiAnalysisFailureReason")))">
                    <!-- Emit trace for observability regardless of fail-open / fail-closed behavior -->
                    <trace source="frag-pii-anonymization" severity="error">
                        <message>@($"PII anonymization degraded: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiAnalysisFailureReason")}")</message>
                        <metadata name="requestId" value="@(context.RequestId.ToString())" />
                        <metadata name="apiName" value="@(context.Api?.Name ?? string.Empty)" />
                        <metadata name="operationName" value="@(context.Operation?.Name ?? string.Empty)" />
                        <metadata name="piiServiceStatusCode" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<IResponse>("piiAnalysisResponse"))?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "n/a")" />
                        <metadata name="continueOnNLPError" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("continueOnNLPError", "false"))" />
                    </trace>
                    <choose>
                        <!-- Fail-closed: return a controlled error to the caller when continueOnNLPError is not enabled -->
                        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("continueOnNLPError", "false").Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == false)">
                            <return-response>
                                <set-status code="502" reason="PII Anonymization Service Unavailable" />
                                <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                                    <value>application/json</value>
                                </set-header>
                                <set-body>@{
                                    var error = new JObject {
                                        ["error"] = new JObject {
                                            ["code"] = "PIIAnonymizationFailed",
                                            ["message"] = "The PII anonymization service is currently unavailable and 'continueOnNLPError' is disabled. Request was blocked to prevent unmasked content from reaching the backend.",
                                            ["details"] = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiAnalysisFailureReason"),
                                            ["requestId"] = context.RequestId.ToString()
                                        }
                                    };
                                    return error.ToString();
                                }</set-body>
                            </return-response>
                        </when>
                        <otherwise>
                            <!-- Fail-open: continue with regex-only mappings so the request can proceed -->
                            <set-variable name="piiMappings" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiRegexMappings") ?? "[]")" />
                        </otherwise>
                    </choose>
                </when>
                <otherwise>
                    <!-- Process PII Analysis Response and store mappings -->
                    <set-variable name="piiMappings" value="@{
                        var response = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<IResponse>("piiAnalysisResponse");
                        var confidenceThreshold = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<double>("piiConfidenceThreshold");
                        var exclusions = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiEntityCategoryExclusions")
                            .Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                            .Select(c => c.Trim())
                            .ToList();

                        var entitiesToken = JObject.Parse(response.Body.As<string>())
                            .SelectToken("$.results.documents[0].entities");
                        var entitiesArray = entitiesToken as JArray ?? new JArray();

                        var entities = entitiesArray
                            .Where(e => e["confidenceScore"] != null && e["confidenceScore"].Value<double>() >= confidenceThreshold)
                            .Where(e => !exclusions.Contains(e["category"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty))
                            .OrderByDescending(e => (e["text"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty).Length);

                        var mappings = new JArray();
                        var categoryCounts = new Dictionary<string, int>();
                        var processedTexts = new HashSet<string>(); // Track already processed texts

                        foreach (var entity in entities) {
                            var text = (entity["text"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty).TrimEnd('.', ',', ' ');
                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) { continue; }

                            // Skip if this text has already been processed
                            if (processedTexts.Contains(text)) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            var category = entity["category"].ToString();

                            if (!categoryCounts.ContainsKey(category)) {
                                categoryCounts[category] = 0;
                            }

                            var placeholder = $"<{category}_{categoryCounts[category]}>";
                            mappings.Add(new JObject {
                                ["original"] = text,
                                ["placeholder"] = placeholder
                            });

                            categoryCounts[category]++;
                            processedTexts.Add(text); // Mark this text as processed
                        }

                        return mappings.ToString();
                    }" />
                </otherwise>
            </choose>

            <!-- Merge API and regex mappings -->
            <set-variable name="piiMappings" value="@{
                var apiMappings = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiMappings") ?? "[]");
                var regexMappings = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiRegexMappings") ?? "[]");
                
                foreach (var mapping in regexMappings)
                {
                    apiMappings.Add(mapping);
                }
                
                return apiMappings.ToString();
            }" />

            <!-- Replace PII with placeholders and set output variable -->
            <set-variable name="piiAnonymizedContent" value="@{
                var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiInputContent");
                var mappings = JArray.Parse(
                    context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiMappings"));
                    
                foreach (var mapping in mappings) {
                    var original = mapping["original"].ToString();
                    var placeholder = mapping["placeholder"].ToString();
                    content = content.Replace(original, placeholder);
                }
                
                return content;
            }" />
        </when>
        <otherwise>
            <!-- When PII anonymization is disabled, just pass through the original content -->
            <set-variable name="piiAnonymizedContent" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiInputContent"))" />
        </otherwise>
    </choose>
</fragment>

<fragment>
    <!-- Replace placeholders with original PII -->
    <set-variable name="piiDeanonymizedContentOutput" value="@{
        var content = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiDeanonymizeContentInput");
        
        // Pre-process content to replace common encoded symbols
        content = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(content, @"\\u003c", "<");
        content = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(content, @"\\u003e", ">");
        
        var mappings = JArray.Parse(
            context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("piiMappings"));
        
        foreach (var mapping in mappings) {
            var original = mapping["original"].ToString();
            var placeholder = mapping["placeholder"].ToString();
            content = content.Replace(placeholder, original);
        }
        return content;
    }" />
</fragment>

<fragment>
    <!--
        Fragment: Path Builder
        Purpose: Reconstructs backend URI paths from known components to ensure all requests route
                 to valid endpoints only. Simplifies client requests by auto-injecting api-version
                 and model fields.

        Path Construction by API Type:
        - Gemini/OpenAI-v1: {api-base-path}/chat/completions
        - Responses API:    {api-base-path} or {api-base-path}/{response-id}
        - Inference API:    {api-base-path}/chat/completions
        - Default OpenAI:   {api-base-path}/deployments/{model}/chat/completions

        Input Variables (from request-processor):
        - api-type: Detected API type
        - api-base-path: Base path for the API type
        - requestedModel: Extracted model identifier
        - response-id: Response ID for GET/DELETE operations on responses API
        - selected-api-version: API version for backend requests

        Output Variables:
        - finalPath: Reconstructed path for backend routing

        Upstream Dependencies:
        - request-processor fragment: Provides all input variables
    -->

    <!-- Skip path building for non-LLM requests (deployment listings handled by operation policies) -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", "") == "non-llm-request")">
            <!-- Non-LLM request - path rewriting skipped, operation-level policy handles response -->
        </when>
        <otherwise>
            <!-- Reconstruct request paths based on API type -->
            <choose>
                <!-- Gemini OpenAI API and OpenAI v1: {api-base-path}/chat/completions -->
                <when condition="@{
                    var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type");
                    return apiType.Equals("geminiopenai", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || apiType.Equals("openai-v1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                }">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var basePath = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-base-path", String.Empty);
                        return !String.IsNullOrEmpty(basePath) ? $"{basePath}/chat/completions" : String.Empty;
                    }" />
                    <set-body>@(context.Request.Body.As<string>())</set-body>
                </when>
                <!-- Amazon Bedrock: /model/{model}/converse -->
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "").Equals("bedrock", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", String.Empty);
                        return !String.IsNullOrEmpty(modelId) ? $"/model/{System.Uri.EscapeDataString(modelId)}/converse" : String.Empty;
                    }" />
                </when>
                <!-- Responses and Inference APIs -->
                <when condition="@{
                    var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", String.Empty);
                    return apiType.StartsWith("responses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || apiType.Equals("inference", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                }">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", String.Empty);
                        var basePath = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-base-path", String.Empty);
                        var responseId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("response-id", String.Empty);

                        if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(basePath)) {
                            return String.Empty;
                        }

                        // Responses API
                        if (apiType.StartsWith("responses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                            var includeResponseId = !String.IsNullOrEmpty(responseId) && (context.Request.Method == "GET" || context.Request.Method == "DELETE");
                            return includeResponseId ? $"{basePath}/{responseId}" : basePath;
                        }

                        // Inference API: {api-base-path}/chat/completions
                        return $"{basePath}/chat/completions";
                    }" />
                    <choose>
                        <!-- Override api-version for responses and inference (v1 infers version from path) -->
                        <when condition="@{
                            var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", String.Empty);
                            return apiType == "responses" || apiType == "inference";
                        }">
                            <set-query-parameter name="api-version" exists-action="override">
                                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("selected-api-version"))</value>
                            </set-query-parameter>
                        </when>
                    </choose>
                </when>
                <!-- OpenAI-Compatible API: uses backend-path-templates for dynamic path construction -->
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "").Equals("openai-compat", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var operation = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("openai-compat-operation", String.Empty);
                        var poolType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("targetPoolType", String.Empty);
                        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", String.Empty);
                        var templates = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("config-backend-path-templates");

                        // Look up path template: backend-path-templates[poolType][operation]
                        var backendTemplates = templates?[poolType] as JObject;
                        var template = backendTemplates?[operation]?.ToString();

                        if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(template)) {
                            return String.Empty;
                        }

                        // Replace {model} placeholder with actual model (URL-encoded for special chars)
                        if (template.Contains("{model}")) {
                            template = template.Replace("{model}", System.Uri.EscapeDataString(modelId));
                        }

                        return template;
                    }" />
                    <!-- Return 400 if no template found for this backend-type × operation -->
                    <choose>
                        <when condition="@(String.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("finalPath", String.Empty)))">
                            <return-response>
                                <set-status code="400" reason="Bad Request" />
                                <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                                    <value>application/json</value>
                                </set-header>
                                <set-body>@{
                                    var operation = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("openai-compat-operation", "unknown");
                                    var poolType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("targetPoolType", "unknown");
                                    return new JObject(
                                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                            new JProperty("message", $"Operation '{operation}' is not supported for backend type '{poolType}'."),
                                            new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                                            new JProperty("code", "unsupported_operation")
                                        ))
                                    ).ToString();
                                }</set-body>
                            </return-response>
                        </when>
                    </choose>
                    <!-- Inject api-version for backends that need it -->
                    <set-query-parameter name="api-version" exists-action="override">
                        <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("selected-api-version"))</value>
                    </set-query-parameter>
                </when>
                <!-- Default OpenAI: {api-base-path}/deployments/{model}/chat/completions -->
                <otherwise>
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var basePath = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-base-path", String.Empty);
                        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", String.Empty);

                        return !String.IsNullOrEmpty(basePath) && !String.IsNullOrEmpty(modelId)
                            ? $"{basePath}/deployments/{modelId}/chat/completions"
                            : String.Empty;
                    }" />
                    <!-- Add model field into request body if not present -->
                    <set-body>@{
                        var body = context.Request.Body.As<string>();
                        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(body)) {
                            try {
                                var parsedBody = JObject.Parse(body);
                                var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", String.Empty);
                                if (parsedBody["model"] == null || String.IsNullOrEmpty(parsedBody["model"].ToString())) {
                                    parsedBody["model"] = modelId;
                                }
                                return parsedBody.ToString();
                            } catch {
                                return body;
                            }
                        }
                        return body;
                    }</set-body>
                    <set-query-parameter name="api-version" exists-action="override">
                        <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("selected-api-version"))</value>
                    </set-query-parameter>
                </otherwise>
            </choose>

            <!-- Handle path configuration errors -->
            <choose>
                <when condition="@(String.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("finalPath", String.Empty)))">
                    <trace source="Path-Builder-Error" severity="error">
                        <message>@($"Unified AI - Path builder error for API type: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type")}")</message>
                    </trace>
                    <return-response>
                        <set-status code="500" reason="Internal Server Error" />
                        <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                            <value>application/json</value>
                        </set-header>
                        <set-body>@{
                            return new JObject(
                                new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("code", "PathBuildError"),
                                    new JProperty("message", $"No path determined for API type: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type")}")
                                ))
                            ).ToString();
                        }</set-body>
                    </return-response>
                </when>
            </choose>

            <!-- Rewrite URI with validated path -->
            <rewrite-uri template="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("finalPath"))" copy-unmatched-params="true" />
        </otherwise>
    </choose>
</fragment>

<fragment>
    <!--
        Fragment: Set Response Headers
        Purpose: Adds UAIG-* response headers exposing internal gateway state for debugging
                 and observability. These headers help trace request processing through the gateway.
                 Headers are only injected when enableResponseHeaders is set to true.

        Requires: enableResponseHeaders (bool, default: false) - Controls whether headers are injected

        Input Variables (all optional, from upstream fragments):
        - auth-type, user-id, subscription-name (from security-handler)
        - requestedModel (from request-processor)
        - api-type, routing-processed-path, selected-api-version, is-streaming (from request-processor)
        - selected-backend (aliased from targetBackendPool in unified-ai-api-policy)
        - cache-operation (from central-cache-manager)
        - config-models (from central-cache-manager)
        - finalPath (from path-builder)

        Output: UAIG-* HTTP response headers (when enableResponseHeaders is true)
    -->

    <choose>
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("enableResponseHeaders", false))">
            <!-- Authentication Context -->
            <set-header name="UAIG-Auth-Type" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("auth-type", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-User-Id" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("user-id", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-Subscription" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("subscription-name", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>

            <!-- Request Processing Context -->
            <set-header name="UAIG-Model-Id" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-API-Type" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-Processed-Path" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("routing-processed-path", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-API-Version" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("selected-api-version", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-Is-Streaming" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("is-streaming", false).ToString().ToLower())</value>
            </set-header>

            <!-- Backend Context -->
            <set-header name="UAIG-Backend" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("selected-backend", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-Final-Path" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("finalPath", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>
            <set-header name="UAIG-Auth-Type-Backend" exists-action="override">
                <value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("targetAuthType", "not-set"))</value>
            </set-header>

            <!-- Model Alias Context -->
            <choose>
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("is-alias", false))">

<fragment>
    <!--
        Fragment: Central Cache Manager
        Purpose: Loads the metadata-config JSON, caches it using APIM internal cache for performance,
                 and parses it into individual typed variables for downstream fragments.

        Input Variables:
        - metadata-config: String - Raw JSON configuration from metadata-config fragment

        Output Variables:
        - config-models: JObject - Parsed models configuration (model name -> backend, apiVersion, timeout)
        - config-api-types: JObject - Parsed API types configuration (api-type -> base-path, path-segment, api-version)
        - config-timeout-settings: JObject - Parsed timeout settings (streaming-multiplier)
        - cache-operation: String - Whether config was loaded from "cache-hit" or "cache-miss"

        Cache Behavior:
        - Uses APIM internal cache with version-based key: "metadata-config-v{config-version}"
        - TTL from cache-settings.ttl-seconds (default 300 seconds)
        - Bypass cache by sending header: UAIG-Config-Cache-Bypass: true

        Upstream Dependencies:
        - metadata-config fragment: Provides the raw JSON configuration string
    -->

    <!-- Check for cache bypass header -->
    <set-variable name="cache-bypass" value="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("UAIG-Config-Cache-Bypass", "false").Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))" />

    <!-- Parse the raw metadata config to extract cache settings -->
    <set-variable name="raw-config" value="@{
        var configStr = (string)context.Variables["metadata-config"];
        try {
            return JObject.Parse(configStr.Replace('\'', '\"'));
        } catch {
            return new JObject();
        }
    }" />

    <!-- Extract cache key from config version -->
    <set-variable name="config-cache-key" value="@{
        var config = (JObject)context.Variables["raw-config"];
        var version = config?["cache-settings"]?["config-version"]?.ToString() ?? "1.0.0";
        return "metadata-config-v" + version;
    }" />

    <!-- Extract cache TTL -->
    <set-variable name="config-cache-ttl" value="@{
        var config = (JObject)context.Variables["raw-config"];
        return config?["cache-settings"]?["ttl-seconds"]?.Value<int>() ?? 300;
    }" />

    <!-- Try to retrieve cached config (skip if bypass requested) -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@(!(bool)context.Variables["cache-bypass"])">
            <cache-lookup-value key="@((string)context.Variables["config-cache-key"])" variable-name="cached-config" default-value="" />
        </when>
        <otherwise>
            <set-variable name="cached-config" value="" />
        </otherwise>
    </choose>

    <!-- Determine if we have a cache hit -->
    <set-variable name="cache-operation" value="@{
        var cached = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("cached-config", "");
        return string.IsNullOrEmpty(cached) ? "cache-miss" : "cache-hit";
    }" />

    <!-- On cache miss, store the parsed config -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["cache-operation"] == "cache-miss")">
            <set-variable name="parsed-config" value="@((JObject)context.Variables["raw-config"])" />
            <!-- Store in cache for future requests -->
            <cache-store-value key="@((string)context.Variables["config-cache-key"])" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["parsed-config"]).ToString())" duration="@((int)context.Variables["config-cache-ttl"])" />
        </when>
        <otherwise>
            <!-- Parse the cached config string back to JObject -->
            <set-variable name="parsed-config" value="@{
                try {
                    return JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["cached-config"]);
                } catch {
                    return (JObject)context.Variables["raw-config"];
                }
            }" />
        </otherwise>
    </choose>

    <!-- Extract individual config sections as typed variables for downstream fragments -->
    <set-variable name="config-models" value="@{
        return ((JObject)context.Variables["parsed-config"])["models"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
    }" />
    <set-variable name="config-api-types" value="@{
        return ((JObject)context.Variables["parsed-config"])["api-types"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
    }" />
    <set-variable name="config-timeout-settings" value="@{
        return ((JObject)context.Variables["parsed-config"])["timeout-settings"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
    }" />
    <set-variable name="config-model-aliases" value="@{
        return ((JObject)context.Variables["parsed-config"])["model-aliases"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
    }" />
    <set-variable name="config-backend-path-templates" value="@{
        return ((JObject)context.Variables["parsed-config"])["backend-path-templates"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
    }" />

    <trace source="Cache-Manager" severity="information">
        <message>@($"Unified AI - Config loaded ({context.Variables["cache-operation"]}), models: {((JObject)context.Variables["config-models"]).Count}, api-types: {((JObject)context.Variables["config-api-types"]).Count}")</message>
    </trace>

        Fragment: Request Processor
        Purpose: Analyzes incoming requests to extract routing context (API type, model, path)
                 and parse JSON bodies. Provides foundational variables used by all downstream fragments.
                 Uses centralized 'requestedModel' variable name for compatibility with existing AI Hub Gateway fragments.
                 Sets apiTypeOverrideBackend when api-type config defines an explicit backend.
                 Sets skipBackendUrlRewrite so set-backend-authorization defers URI rewriting to path-builder.

        Input Variables:
        - context.Request.Url.Path: Request path to analyze
        - context.Request.Body: Request body for JSON parsing
        - context.Api.Path: API path prefix to remove
        - config-api-types: API type configuration from central-cache-manager
        - config-models: Models configuration from central-cache-manager

        Output Variables:
        - api-type: Detected API type (openai|inference|responses|responses-v1|openai-v1|geminiopenai)
        - requestedModel: Extracted model identifier (uses same variable name as frag-set-llm-requested-model.xml)
        - routing-processed-path: Request path with API prefix removed (always has leading slash)
        - response-id: Response ID for GET/DELETE operations on responses API
        - parsed-request-body: Parsed JSON object from request body (empty JObject for GET/DELETE or parse failure)
        - selected-api-version: API version for backend requests (model-specific or api-type default)
        - is-streaming: Whether request has stream:true ("true"/"false")
        - apiTypeOverrideBackend: Backend from api-type config (empty if model-based routing should be used)
        - skipBackendUrlRewrite: Always set to "true" — path-builder handles URI construction for Unified AI

        Downstream Consumers:
        - path-builder fragment: Uses api-type, routing-processed-path, response-id for backend path building
        - set-target-backend-pool fragment: Uses requestedModel, apiTypeOverrideBackend for routing
        - set-backend-authorization fragment: Respects skipBackendUrlRewrite to skip URL rewriting
        - set-llm-usage fragment: Uses requestedModel for metrics
        - validate-model-access fragment: Uses requestedModel for access check
        - set-response-headers fragment: Uses routing information for debugging

        Upstream Dependencies:
        - central-cache-manager fragment: Provides config-api-types, config-models
    -->

    <!-- Remove API path prefix: /unified-ai/openai/chat/completions -> /openai/chat/completions -->
    <set-variable name="routing-processed-path" value="@(context.Request.Url.Path.Replace(context.Api.Path, "").TrimStart('/').Insert(0, "/"))" />

    <!-- Determine API type from request path by matching against configured base-paths.
         Uses prefix matching (StartsWith) instead of substring (Contains) so that
         unrecognized prefixes like /v2/openai/... do NOT accidentally match /openai.
         Picks the longest matching base-path so that nested prefixes
         (e.g. /openai/v1/responses vs /openai/v1 vs /openai) resolve to the most specific api-type
         independent of declaration order. -->
    <set-variable name="api-type" value="@{
        try {
            var path = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("routing-processed-path", String.Empty).ToLower();
            string bestName = String.Empty;
            int bestLength = -1;
            var apiTypes = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("config-api-types");
            if (apiTypes != null) {
                foreach (var prop in apiTypes.Children<JProperty>()) {
                    var basePath = prop.Value["base-path"]?.ToString();
                    if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(basePath)) { continue; }
                    var basePathLower = basePath.ToLower();
                    if (path.StartsWith(basePathLower, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        && basePathLower.Length > bestLength) {
                        bestName = prop.Name;
                        bestLength = basePathLower.Length;

            <!-- Use API type to look up base path and path segment from metadata configuration -->

    <set-variable name="api-path-segment" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("api-type-config")?["path-segment"]?.ToString() ?? String.Empty)" />

    <!-- Set apiTypeOverrideBackend when api-type config defines an explicit backend (e.g., responses → responses-backend) -->
    <!-- This tells set-target-backend-pool to bypass pool-based model matching and use this backend directly -->
    <set-variable name="apiTypeOverrideBackend" value="@{
        var apiTypeConfig = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("api-type-config");
        return apiTypeConfig?["backend"]?.ToString() ?? String.Empty;
    }" />

    <!-- Signal that path-builder handles URI construction — set-backend-authorization should skip URL rewriting -->
    <set-variable name="skipBackendUrlRewrite" value="true" />

    <!-- Parse request body for POST/PUT/PATCH methods -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@(context.Request.Method == "GET" || context.Request.Method == "DELETE")">
            <!-- No body for these methods -->
        </when>
        <otherwise>
            <set-variable name="parsed-request-body" value="@{
                try {
                    return JObject.Parse(context.Request.Body.As<string>(preserveContent: true));
                } catch {
                    return new JObject();
                }
            }" />
            <!-- Detect if request is streaming -->
            <set-variable name="is-streaming" value="@{
                var body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("parsed-request-body");
                var streamValue = body?["stream"];
                return streamValue != null && streamValue.Type == JTokenType.Boolean && streamValue.Value<bool>();
            }" />
        </otherwise>
    </choose>

    <!-- Extract model from request body or path, using 'requestedModel' for AI Hub Gateway compatibility -->
    <set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
        try {
            var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "openai");
            var method = context.Request.Method;

            // GET requests are non-LLM operations (deployment listings, etc.)
            if (method.Equals("GET", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return "non-llm-request";
            }

            // DELETE requests on responses API don't need a model
            if (method.Equals("DELETE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && apiType.StartsWith("responses"))
            {
                return "non-llm-request";
            }

            // Try body first (works for all API types)
            var bodyModel = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("parsed-request-body")?["model"]?.ToString();
            if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(bodyModel))
            {
                return bodyModel;
            }

            // Try path extraction using api-path-segment (e.g., /openai/deployments/{model}/...)
            var segment = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-path-segment", String.Empty);
            if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(segment))
            {
                var path = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("routing-processed-path", String.Empty);
                var idx = path.IndexOf(segment + "/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                if (idx >= 0)
                {
                    var afterSegment = path.Substring(idx + segment.Length + 1);
                    var modelName = afterSegment.Split('/')[0];
                    if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(modelName))
                    {
                        return modelName;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch { }
        return String.Empty;
    }" />

    <!-- Extract operation for openai-compat api-type (e.g., /v1/chat/completions → chat/completions) -->
    <set-variable name="openai-compat-operation" value="@{
        var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "");
        if (!apiType.Equals("openai-compat", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            return String.Empty;
        }
        var path = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("routing-processed-path", "");
        // Remove /v1/ prefix to get the operation
        var idx = path.IndexOf("/v1/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (idx >= 0) {
            return path.Substring(idx + 4).TrimEnd('/');
        }
        var trimmed = path.TrimStart('/');
        return trimmed.Substring(Math.Min(3, trimmed.Length)).TrimStart('/');
    }" />

    <!-- Extract response-id for openai-compat responses operations (e.g., /v1/responses/{id}) -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@{
            var op = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("openai-compat-operation", "");
            return op.StartsWith("responses/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }">
            <set-variable name="response-id" value="@{
                var op = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("openai-compat-operation", "");
                var parts = op.Split('/');
                return parts.Length > 1 ? parts[1] : String.Empty;
            }" />
            <set-variable name="openai-compat-operation" value="responses" />
        </when>
    </choose>

    <!-- Model alias resolution: check if requestedModel is an alias and resolve to actual model -->
    <set-variable name="original-model-alias" value="" />
    <set-variable name="is-alias" value="@(false)" />
    <set-variable name="alias-models" value="@(new JArray())" />
    <choose>
        <when condition="@{
            var model = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", "");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(model) || model == "non-llm-request") { return false; }
            var aliases = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("config-model-aliases");
            return aliases != null && aliases.Property(model) != null;
        }">
            <set-variable name="original-model-alias" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", ""))" />
            <set-variable name="is-alias" value="@(true)" />
            <set-variable name="alias-models" value="@{
                var alias = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", "");
                var aliases = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("config-model-aliases");
                if (aliases == null) { return new JArray(); }
                var prop = aliases.Property(alias);
                if (prop == null) { return new JArray(); }
                var aliasEntry = prop.Value as JObject;
                if (aliasEntry == null) { return new JArray(); }
                var modelsProp = aliasEntry.Property("models");
                if (modelsProp == null) { return new JArray(); }
                var models = modelsProp.Value as JArray;
                return models ?? new JArray();
            }" />
            <set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
                var alias = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("original-model-alias", "");
                var aliases = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("config-model-aliases");
                if (aliases == null) { return alias; }
                var prop = aliases.Property(alias);
                if (prop == null) { return alias; }
                var aliasConfig = prop.Value as JObject;
                if (aliasConfig == null) { return alias; }
                var modelsProp = aliasConfig.Property("models");
                if (modelsProp == null) { return alias; }
                var models = modelsProp.Value as JArray;
                if (models == null || models.Count == 0) { return alias; }

                var strategyProp = aliasConfig.Property("strategy");
                var strategy = strategyProp != null ? strategyProp.Value.ToString() : "priority";
                if (strategy.Equals("weighted", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    // Weighted round-robin using cache counter
                    var weightsProp = aliasConfig.Property("weights");
                    var weights = weightsProp != null ? weightsProp.Value as JArray : null;
                    if (weights != null && weights.Count == models.Count)
                    {
                        var productId = context.Product != null ? context.Product.Id : "default";
                        var cacheKey = "alias-counter-" + alias + "-" + productId;
                        int counter = 0;
                        try {
                            if (context.Variables.ContainsKey(cacheKey)) {
                                var cached = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>(cacheKey, "");
                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cached)) { int.TryParse(cached, out counter); }
                            }
                        } catch { }

                        int totalWeight = 0;
                        foreach (var w in weights) { totalWeight += w.Value<int>(); }
                        int pick = counter % Math.Max(totalWeight, 1);
                        int cumulative = 0;
                        for (int i = 0; i < models.Count; i++)
                        {
                            cumulative += weights[i].Value<int>();
                            if (pick < cumulative) { return models[i].ToString(); }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Default: priority — return first model
                return models[0].ToString();
            }" />
        </when>
    </choose>

    <!-- Validate that model parameter is present (skip for non-LLM requests) -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["requestedModel"] == "non-llm-request")">
            <!-- Non-LLM request (e.g., GET operations like listing models) - skip model validation -->
        </when>
        <when condition="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables["requestedModel"]))">
            <return-response>
                <set-status code="400" reason="Bad Request" />
                <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                    <value>application/json</value>
                </set-header>
                <set-body>@{
                    return new JObject(
                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                            new JProperty("message", "Model could not be detected from request body or path"),
                            new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                            new JProperty("code", "missing_model_parameter"),
                            new JProperty("param", "model")
                        ))
                    ).ToString();
                }</set-body>
            </return-response>
        </when>
    </choose>

    <!-- Determine response ID from request path (for responses API GET/DELETE operations) -->
    <set-variable name="response-id" value="@{
        var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "openai");
        var method = context.Request.Method;
        if (!apiType.StartsWith("responses") || (method != "GET" && method != "DELETE")) {
            return String.Empty;
        }
        var path = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("routing-processed-path", String.Empty);
        return path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    }" />

    <!-- Determine API version from model config or api-type config -->
    <set-variable name="selected-api-version" value="@{
        var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "openai");
        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", "unknown");
        var models = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("config-models");
        var apiTypeConfig = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("api-type-config");

        // Model-specific API versions
        var modelConfig = models?[modelId];
        if (modelConfig != null) {
            if (apiType.Equals("inference", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && modelConfig["inferenceApiVersion"] != null) {
                return modelConfig["inferenceApiVersion"].ToString();
            }
            if (apiType.Equals("openai", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && modelConfig["apiVersion"] != null) {
                return modelConfig["apiVersion"].ToString();
            }
        }

        // Fall back to api-type config version
        var apiTypeVersion = apiTypeConfig?["api-version"]?.ToString();
        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(apiTypeVersion)) {
            return apiTypeVersion;
        }

        // Fallback defaults
        return apiType.Equals("responses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "2025-03-01-preview" : "2024-10-21";
    }" />

    <trace source="Request-Processor" severity="information">
        <message>@($"Unified AI - Request processed: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("routing-processed-path", "n/a")} | API: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("api-type", "n/a")} | Model: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", "n/a")} | Alias: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("original-model-alias", "")} | Op: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("openai-compat-operation", "")} | Streaming: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("is-streaming", false)}")</message>
    </trace>
</fragment>

        Fragment: Validate Model Access
        Purpose: Restricts access to specific models based on the allowedModels variable
        
        Expected Input Variables:
        - requestedModel: The model name extracted from the request (set by set-llm-requested-model fragment)
        - allowedModels: Comma-separated list of allowed model names (e.g., "gpt-4o,deepseek-r1")
        
        Behavior:
        - Non-LLM requests (e.g., GET operations like listing models) are always allowed
        - If allowedModels is empty, all models are allowed
        - If requestedModel is not in allowedModels, returns 403 Forbidden
        
        Usage:
        1. Set allowedModels variable before including this fragment
        2. Include this fragment after set-llm-requested-model
        
        Example:
        <set-variable name="allowedModels" value="gpt-4o,deepseek-r1" />
        <include-fragment fragment-id="validate-model-access" />
    -->
    
    <!-- Restrict access for this product to specific models (skip for non-LLM requests like GET operations) -->
    <choose>
        <when condition="@((context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel") ?? string.Empty).Equals("non-llm-request", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
            <!-- Non-LLM request (e.g., GET operations) - skip model access control -->
        </when>
        <when condition="@{
            var allowedModelsVar = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("allowedModels") ?? string.Empty;
            
            // If no allowed models specified, allow all models
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(allowedModelsVar))
            {
                return false; // Don't block
            }
            
            var allowedModels = allowedModelsVar.Split(',').Select(m => m.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()).ToArray();

<fragment>
    <!--
        Fragment: Responses API ID Security (inbound)
        Purpose: Provides per-subscription ownership enforcement and backend-routing hydration
                 for the OpenAI-compatible Responses API (`/responses` family of operations).

                 Designed to be reused unchanged by all three AI Hub Gateway API surfaces
                 (Azure OpenAI, Universal LLM, Unified AI) by relying only on standard
                 context variables and (optionally) the `response-id` / `parsed-request-body`
                 variables already produced by `frag-request-processor` (Unified AI).

        Scope (only when the request targets the Responses API):
        - POST /<base>/responses                            → first-time creation; cache will be set in outbound
        - GET  /<base>/responses/{response_id}              → ownership check + hydrate routing
        - GET  /<base>/responses/{response_id}/input_items  → ownership check + hydrate routing
        - DELETE /<base>/responses/{response_id}            → ownership check + hydrate routing
        - POST with `previous_response_id` in body          → ownership check on the chained response_id

        Cache contract (APIM internal cache, key prefix `response-id-`):
            key   = "response-id-" + response_id
            value = "<subscriptionId>|<requestedModel>|<userId>"
            ttl   = 24h (86400s) – matches typical Responses API server-side retention window

        Behaviour summary:
        1. Detect Responses API requests by path (segment `/responses`).
        2. Resolve the response_id from URL (GET/DELETE) or from `previous_response_id` (POST chained).
           Reuses `response-id` already extracted by frag-request-processor when available.
        3. Look up the cached owner. If the cached subscription does NOT match the calling
           subscription → return 403 Forbidden (cross-subscription access blocked).
        4. For GET/DELETE on /responses/{id}: hydrate `requestedModel` from the cache so that
           the existing `set-target-backend-pool` fragment selects the same backend pool that
           served the original POST – this fixes routing for these previously model-less ops.
        5. For GET/DELETE with NO cached entry (e.g., id was never created via this gateway, or
           cache evicted past the 24h TTL) → return 404 Not Found with a deterministic error.

        Required upstream variables:
        - context.Subscription           – APIM subscription that authenticated the call.
        - user-id (optional)             – Set by frag-security-handler from JWT or subscription.
        - response-id (optional)         – Set by frag-request-processor (Unified AI). Reused if present.
        - parsed-request-body (optional) – Set by frag-request-processor (Unified AI). Reused if present.

        Output variables (consumed by frag-set-target-backend-pool and outbound store fragment):
        - isResponsesApi    : bool  – True when the request targets a /responses* operation.
        - responseId        : string – Resolved response_id (empty when none present).
        - cachedResponseOwner : string – Raw cache value, empty if cache miss.
        - requestedModel    : string – Hydrated from cache for GET/DELETE on existing responses.
    -->

    <!-- 1. Detect Responses API operations from path segments and (when available) from
            an upstream `response-id` already extracted by frag-request-processor. Segment-based
            matching avoids false negatives from substring/encoding edge cases and matches both
            `/responses` and `/v1/responses`. -->
    <set-variable name="isResponsesApi" value="@{
        // Reuse signal from frag-request-processor when present (Unified AI path).
        var existingResponseId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("response-id", string.Empty);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(existingResponseId)) { return true; }

        // Try Url.Path and OriginalUrl.Path (some APIM flows expose only one).
        var path = context.Request.Url?.Path ?? string.Empty;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
        {
            try { path = context.Request.OriginalUrl?.Path ?? string.Empty; } catch { }
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) { return false; }

        // Segment-based match: any path segment equal to "responses" (case-insensitive).
        var segments = path.Split(new[] { '/' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        foreach (var seg in segments)
        {
            if (seg.Equals("responses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return true; }
        }
        return false;
    }" />

    <choose>
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isResponsesApi", false))">

            <!-- 2. Resolve response_id (URL for GET/DELETE, `previous_response_id` body field for POST). -->
            <set-variable name="responseId" value="@{
                // Reuse value already extracted by frag-request-processor (Unified AI) when available.
                var existing = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("response-id", string.Empty);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(existing)) { return existing.Trim(); }

                var method = context.Request.Method ?? string.Empty;

                // Prefer APIM-matched route parameter when the operation defines one (e.g., {response_id}).
                try
                {
                    if (context.Request.MatchedParameters != null
                        && context.Request.MatchedParameters.ContainsKey("response_id"))
                    {
                        var matched = context.Request.MatchedParameters["response_id"];
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(matched)) { return matched.Trim(); }
                    }
                }
                catch { }

                var path = context.Request.Url?.Path ?? string.Empty;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                {
                    try { path = context.Request.OriginalUrl?.Path ?? string.Empty; } catch { }
                }

                // GET / DELETE / sub-collections like /input_items live under /responses/{id}/...
                if (!method.Equals("POST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    var segments = path.Split(new[] { '/' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                    for (int i = 0; i < segments.Length - 1; i++)
                    {
                        if (segments[i].Equals("responses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            return segments[i + 1].Trim();
                        }
                    }
                    return string.Empty;
                }

                // POST – chained calls may carry previous_response_id in the body.
                try
                {
                    var bodyObj = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("parsed-request-body");
                    if (bodyObj == null)
                    {
                        var raw = context.Request.Body.As<string>(preserveContent: true);
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw)) { return string.Empty; }
                        bodyObj = JObject.Parse(raw);
                    }
                    var prev = bodyObj["previous_response_id"]?.ToString();
                    return string.IsNullOrEmpty(prev) ? string.Empty : prev.Trim();
                }
                catch { return string.Empty; }
            }" />

            <!-- 3. Look up cached owner (only when we actually have a response_id to validate). -->
            <choose>
                <when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("responseId", string.Empty)))">
                    <cache-lookup-value key="@("response-id-" + (string)context.Variables["responseId"])" variable-name="cachedResponseOwner" caching-type="internal" />

                    <!-- 3a. Ownership enforcement: cached subscription must match current subscription. -->
                    <choose>
                        <when condition="@{
                            var cached = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("cachedResponseOwner", string.Empty);
                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cached)) { return false; }
                            var parts = cached.Split('|');
                            var cachedSubId = parts.Length > 0 ? parts[0] : string.Empty;
                            var currentSubId = context.Subscription?.Id ?? string.Empty;
                            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cachedSubId)
                                && !cachedSubId.Equals(currentSubId, StringComparison.Ordinal);
                        }">
                            <trace source="Responses-API-Security" severity="error">
                                <message>@($"Response-id ownership mismatch. responseId={context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("responseId", string.Empty)} requestSub={context.Subscription?.Id ?? string.Empty}")</message>
                            </trace>
                            <return-response>
                                <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
                                <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                                    <value>application/json</value>
                                </set-header>
                                <set-body>@{
                                    return new JObject(
                                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                            new JProperty("message", "Access denied. The supplied response_id was created by a different subscription and cannot be accessed."),
                                            new JProperty("type", "access_error"),
                                            new JProperty("code", "response_id_forbidden")
                                        ))
                                    ).ToString();
                                }</set-body>
                            </return-response>
                        </when>
                    </choose>

                    <!-- 3b. For non-POST methods, hydrate `requestedModel` from cache so that
                              the existing set-target-backend-pool routes to the original backend. -->
                    <choose>
                        <when condition="@{
                            var method = context.Request.Method ?? string.Empty;
                            if (method.Equals("POST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return false; }
                            var cached = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("cachedResponseOwner", string.Empty);
                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cached)) { return false; }
                            var parts = cached.Split('|');
                            return parts.Length >= 2 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(parts[1]);
                        }">
                            <set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
                                var cached = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("cachedResponseOwner", string.Empty);
                                return cached.Split('|')[1];
                            }" />
                            <trace source="Responses-API-Security" severity="information">
                                <message>@($"Hydrated requestedModel='{context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("requestedModel", string.Empty)}' from response-id cache for {context.Request.Method} {context.Request.Url.Path}")</message>
                            </trace>
                        </when>
                    </choose>

                    <!-- 3c. GET/DELETE on /responses/{id} with no cache entry → 404 (unknown id at gateway). -->
                    <choose>
                        <when condition="@{
                            var method = context.Request.Method ?? string.Empty;
                            if (method.Equals("POST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return false; }
                            var cached = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("cachedResponseOwner", string.Empty);
                            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(cached);
                        }">
                            <trace source="Responses-API-Security" severity="information">
                                <message>@($"Response-id cache miss on {context.Request.Method} {context.Request.Url.Path}. Returning 404.")</message>
                            </trace>
                            <return-response>
                                <set-status code="404" reason="Not Found" />
                                <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                                    <value>application/json</value>
                                </set-header>
                                <set-body>@{
                                    return new JObject(
                                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                            new JProperty("message", $"The supplied response_id '{context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("responseId", string.Empty)}' is not known to the gateway. It was either never created here or the ownership cache entry has expired."),
                                            new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                                            new JProperty("code", "response_id_not_found")
                                        ))
                                    ).ToString();
                                }</set-body>
                            </return-response>
                        </when>
                    </choose>
                </when>
            </choose>
        </when>
    </choose>
</fragment>

            value = "<subscriptionId>|<requestedModel>|<userId>"
            ttl   = 86400 seconds (24h) – matches typical OpenAI server-side retention.

        - isResponsesApi          – set by frag-responses-id-security
        - context.Subscription.Id – APIM
        - requestedModel          – set by frag-set-llm-requested-model / frag-request-processor
        - user-id                 – set by frag-security-handler (falls back to subscription id)

        Diagnostic headers (added only for cached responses):
        - x-aihub-response-id-cached: response_id that was just cached
    -->

    <choose>
        <when condition="@(
            context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isResponsesApi", false)
            && (context.Request.Method ?? string.Empty).Equals("POST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            && context.Response != null
            && context.Response.StatusCode >= 200

                    var raw = context.Response.Body.As<string>(preserveContent: true);
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw)) { return string.Empty; }

                    return json["id"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
